sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at my hotel, looking at tickets for the viewing deck.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'd like to go on Monday, so I open the chat.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I use a weekday ticket on Monday?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, weekday tickets work from Monday to Friday.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, does this ticket have a set entry time?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, pick an entry time when you book online.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I choose two in the afternoon for Monday?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The two o'clock slot's full, but we've still got space at two thirty.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which time can I still book?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Two thirty on Monday.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I'll book the two thirty entry.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I pick the later time and finish my booking.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got my ticket number, but where's the ticket?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Open your email and tap the link to your ticket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I download my ticket from that page?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, tap Download and save the file to your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Do I need to print it before I go?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, you can show it on your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I open the saved ticket offline?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, once you've saved the file, it'll open offline.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data after saving the ticket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It opens offline, and I can see the whole ticket.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, have it ready when you get to the entrance.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I get there right at my entry time?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Get there ten minutes before your entry time.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So I'll get there at two twenty on Monday.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, then show your ticket at the entrance.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll save the arrival time in my calendar.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're all set, enjoy the view on Monday.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got my ticket and know when to get there.
